source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice short questions written from Chapter 22 (PDF 186-207), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 22 (Biostatistics) ke poore chapter se practice short questions (mukhtasar sawal) hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein, Board ke 2 number wale sawal ke andaz mein. Har sawal ka mukhtasar model jawab hai; chhote numericals mein hal ke qadam hain, aur farq wale sawal ka jawab table mein hai.

blocks.prompt:
1 Define biostatistics.
(Biostatistics (hayati shumariyat) ki definition likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Biostatistics aik scientific shoba hai jo statistical methods aur techniques ko khaas taur par biological, medical aur sehat se mutaliq data par lagata hai. Is mein data jama karna, pesh karna, analysis (tajziya) aur interpretation (tashreeh) shamil hai taa ke ba-maani nataij nikal sakein.

book_ref.quote: Biostatistics is a scientific discipline that applies statistical methods

blocks.prompt:
2 Why does biostatistical analysis use sample data instead of the whole population? Give the book's example.
(Biostatistical analysis poori population ke bajaye sample data kyun istemal karti hai? Kitab ki misaal dein.)
blocks.explanation: Poori population ko test karna na-qabil-e-amal ya mehnga ho sakta hai, is liye sample data se population ke baare mein faisle hote hain. Misaal: workers ke numainda subset ko parh kar tamam workers mein kisi sehat ki halat ke phailao (prevalence) ka andaza lagta hai.

book_ref.quote: For example, by studying a representative subset of workers in a population

blocks.prompt:
3 What does study design and experimental planning include?
(Study design aur experimental planning mein kya shamil hai?)
blocks.explanation: Is mein research ka sawal banana, maqasid tay karna aur hypothesis test karne ke liye experiments ya observational studies ki tarteeb shamil hai. Population chunna, variables tay karna, randomization, confounding factors control karna aur munasib sample size nikalna bhi is ka hissa hain.

book_ref.quote: It includes selecting the population, defining variables, randomization

blocks.prompt:
4 Differentiate between primary and secondary data collection.
(Primary aur secondary data collection mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Primary data seedha jama hota hai; secondary data pehle se mojood data hota hai.

book_ref.quote: Primary Data Collection: Direct data from experiments, surveys, interviews, observations, and clinical trials.

rows: Researcher ka seedha jama kiya data
Doosron ka pehle se jama kiya hua mojood data
Zarai: experiments, surveys, interviews, observations, clinical trials
Zarai: published research, medical records, government reports, databases

blocks.prompt:
5 What is meant by data management and processing?
(Data management and processing se kya muraad hai?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh jama shuda data ko baqaida tarteeb dena aur analysis se pehle us ki durusti yaqeeni banana hai. Is mein data cleaning (safai), coding aur storage shamil hain, raazdari aur durusti (integrity) ke saath.

book_ref.quote: Organizing the collected data systematically and ensuring accuracy before analysis.

blocks.prompt:
6 What is data analysis? Name two techniques of inferential statistics.
(Data analysis kya hai? Inferential statistics ki do techniques ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Data analysis statistical techniques ka istemal hai taa ke data ka khulasa, bayan aur us se nataij (inferences) nikale jayein. Do inferential techniques: hypothesis testing aur regression analysis (modelling bhi).

book_ref.quote: Application of statistical techniques to summarize, describe, and draw inferences from data.

blocks.prompt:
7 What is interpretation of results? What must be considered during it?
(Interpretation of results kya hai? Is mein kin baaton ka khayal zaroori hai?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh statistical nataij ko ba-maani biological ya sehat ke nataij mein badalna hai. Analysis ka context, hudood (limitations) aur mafrozat (assumptions) dekhna zaroori hai.

book_ref.quote: Consideration of context, limitations, and assumptions of the analysis is important.

blocks.prompt:
8 How are results presented and communicated in biostatistics?
(Biostatistics mein nataij kaise pesh aur bayan kiye jaate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Nataij visualizations (charts, graphs) aur saaf zabaan mein pesh kiye jaate hain jo scientific, medical aur aam audience ke mutabiq ho. Methods aur nataij ki shaffaf reporting reproducibility aur bharose ke liye zaroori hai.

book_ref.quote: Effectively communicating results using visualizations (charts, graphs)

blocks.prompt:
9 Write the role of biostatistics in epidemiology.
(Epidemiology (wabaiyat) mein biostatistics ka kirdar likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Yeh population mein bimariyon ke phailao aur asbaab ki tehqeeq karti hai, batati hai ke bimariyan kaise phailti hain, risk factors pehchanti hai aur hifazati iqdamat ka asar jaanchti hai. Bimari ke rujhanat ki modelling se wabaon ke control mein madad deti hai.

book_ref.quote: It helps public health experts understand how diseases spread, identify risk factors

blocks.prompt:
10 What is personalized medicine? How is biostatistics related to it?
(Personalized medicine kya hai? Biostatistics ka is se kya taluq hai?)
blocks.explanation: Personalized medicine mein ilaj fard ki genetic profile ke mutabiq banaya jata hai taa ke asar barhe aur nuqsandeh asraat kam hon. Genetic data ka analysis karne wale biostatistical methods is ke liye zaroori hain.

book_ref.quote: where treatments are tailored to an individual

blocks.prompt:
11 How does biostatistics help in shaping public health policy?
(Biostatistics public health policy banane mein kaise madad deti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh population ke sehat data ka analysis aur health programs ka jaiza leti hai. Kamzor groups aur sehat ki na-barabariyan pehchan kar policymakers ko aise iqdamat ke liye saboot deti hai jo barabari barhayein.

book_ref.quote: providing policymakers with evidence to design and implement interventions

blocks.prompt:
12 Give the use of biostatistics in environmental health.
(Environmental health mein biostatistics ka istemal batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Yeh jaanchti hai ke pollution (aaloodgi) aur toxins jaise mahol ke awamil insani sehat ko kaise mutasir karte hain. Statistical analysis nuqsandeh exposures pehchanta hai aur hifazat ke qawaneen aur hikmat-e-amli ki rehnumai karta hai.

book_ref.quote: Statistical analysis helps identify harmful exposures and guides regulations

blocks.prompt:
13 What is the role of biostatistics in bioinformatics?
(Bioinformatics mein biostatistics ka kya kirdar hai?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh genomics aur proteomics ke bare datasets ke analysis mein madad deti hai. Algorithms aur models bana kar complex data ki tashreeh mumkin banati hai jo dawa ki daryaft, bimari ki tashkhees aur personalized ilaj ke liye zaroori hai.

book_ref.quote: By developing algorithms and models, biostatisticians enable the interpretation of complex data

blocks.prompt:
14 How is biostatistics used in healthcare quality control?
(Healthcare quality control mein biostatistics kaise istemal hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Healthcare providers statistical tools se diagnostic tests ki durusti jaanchte, mareezon ke nataij par nazar rakhte aur medical procedures mein yaksaaniyat yaqeeni banate hain, jis se mareezon ki dekh bhaal behtar hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: ensure consistency in medical procedures, ultimately enhancing the quality of patient care

blocks.prompt:
15 Write the role of biostatistics in controlling epidemics.
(Wabaon par qaboo mein biostatistics ka kirdar likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Wabaon mein yeh bimari ka phailao dekhti, mortality rates ka andaza lagati aur khatre wali population pehchanti hai. Yeh foran hone wala analysis faislon aur outbreaks rokne ki hikmat-e-amli mein madad deta hai.

book_ref.quote: This real-time statistical analysis informs decision-making

blocks.prompt:
16 How does biostatistics help in health programs and population interventions?
(Biostatistics health programs aur population interventions mein kaise madad deti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh health programs ka asar jaanchti hai, maslan immunization mohimon, sehat ki taleem aur healthcare workers ki training ka asar. Is se wasail ki behtar taqseem aur public health iqdamat ka zyada faida hota hai.

book_ref.quote: This evaluation is vital for optimizing resource allocation

blocks.prompt:
17 How does biostatistics identify barriers to care?
(Biostatistics healthcare ki rukawatein kaise pehchanti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh survey data aur health services ke istemal ke patterns ka analysis kar ke healthcare tak rasai ki rukawatein dhoondti hai. Phir providers aur policymakers rasai behtar karne aur na-barabari kam karne ki hikmat-e-amli banate hain.

book_ref.quote: develop strategies to improve access and reduce health disparities

blocks.prompt:
18 What is the role of biostatistics in health risk assessment and demography?
(Health risk assessment aur demography mein biostatistics ka kya kirdar hai?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh paidaish, amwaat, bimari ke phailao aur doosre vital statistics ke rujhanat ka analysis karti hai. Yeh maloomat government idaron aur health organizations ko services ki planning, wasail ki taqseem aur sehat ke masail hal karne mein madad deti hai.

book_ref.quote: These analysis provide crucial information for government agencies and health organizations

blocks.text: 22.2 Key statistical measures and their calculation

blocks.prompt:
19 Name the measures of central tendency and the measures of spread given in the chapter.
(Chapter mein diye gaye central tendency aur spread (phailao) ke measures ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Central tendency ke measures: mean (average), median (darmiyani nuqta) aur mode (sab se zyada aane wali qeemat). Phailao ke measures: standard deviation aur range. Percentiles data ko makhsoos hisson mein baant dete hain.

book_ref.quote: These measures provide valuable insights into the central tendency, variability, and distribution of data

blocks.prompt:
20 Define mean. Write its biological use.
(Mean ki definition likhein. Is ka biological istemal batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Mean (average) central tendency ka measure hai jo data ki markazi qeemat deta hai. Biology mein yeh bare data ka khulasa aik markazi qeemat se karta hai jo aam khususiyaat batati hai, jaise average size ya growth rate.

book_ref.quote: it can be used to summarize large datasets, providing a central value

blocks.prompt:
21 Write the formula for the mean of grouped data and explain its terms.
(Grouped data ke mean ka formula likhein aur us ke terms samjhayein.)
blocks.explanation: Mean = Σfᵢxᵢ / Σfᵢ, jahan xᵢ = ith class interval ka midpoint, fᵢ = ith class ki frequency aur Σfᵢ = tamam frequencies ka majmua.

book_ref.quote: Σfᵢ = sum of all the frequencies.

blocks.prompt:
22 The lengths of five lizards are 18, 22, 20, 25 and 15 cm. Calculate their mean length.
(Paanch chhipkaliyon ki lambai 18, 22, 20, 25 aur 15 cm hai. Un ki mean lambai nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: Step 2: Count the total number of birds (n)

blocks.prompt:
23 Find the midpoint xᵢ and fᵢxᵢ for the class 40–50 having frequency 6.
(Frequency 6 wali class 40–50 ke liye midpoint xᵢ aur fᵢxᵢ nikalein.)
blocks.explanation:
xᵢ = (lower limit + upper limit)/2 = (40 + 50)/2 = 45.
fᵢxᵢ = 6 × 45 = 270.

book_ref.quote: Step 3: Multiply each midpoint by its corresponding frequency.

blocks.prompt:
24 Define median. When is it a better measure of central tendency in biology?
(Median ki definition likhein. Biology mein yeh kab behtar markazi measure hai?)
blocks.explanation: Median tarteeb di gayi data ki darmiyani qeemat hai; juft tadaad mein do darmiyani qeematon ka average. Population size, bimari ke phailao ya jism ki pemaishon mein, jahan data normal distribution mein na ho, yeh behtar markazi qeemat deta hai.

book_ref.quote: If the number of values in data set is even, the median is the average of the two middle numbers.

blocks.prompt:
25 How is the position of the median found for an odd and for an even number of values?
(Taaq aur juft tadaad ki qeematon mein median ki position kaise maloom hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Data ko tarteeb dene ke baad: agar n taaq ho to median ((n + 1)/2)th position wali qeemat hai. Agar n juft ho to median (n/2)th aur (n/2 + 1)th positions ki qeematon ka average hai.

book_ref.quote: Step 4: If the number of values in the dataset is even

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Book correction yaad rakhein: juft n mein doosri position (n/2 + 1) hai, (n + 1)/2 nahi. Maslan n = 6 mein 3rd aur 4th qeematein lein, aur pehle dono ko jama kar ke phir 2 se taqseem karein.

blocks.prompt:
26 The numbers of eggs in four nests are 7, 3, 9 and 5. Find the median.
(Chaar ghonslon mein andon ki tadaad 7, 3, 9 aur 5 hai. Median nikalein.)
blocks.explanation:
Tarteeb: 3, 5, 7, 9; n = 4 (juft). Darmiyani qeematein positions 2 aur 3 par: 5 aur 7.
Median = (5 + 7)/2 = 6 ande.

book_ref.quote: Step 3: If the number of values in the dataset is odd

blocks.prompt:
27 Define mode and give two biological examples of its use.
(Mode ki definition likhein aur is ke istemal ki do biological misalein dein.)
blocks.explanation: Mode woh qeemat ya qeematein hain jo data mein sab se zyada baar aayein. Misalein: paude par phoolon ki sab se zyada aane wali tadaad; population mein beejon ka sab se aam size (ya janwaron ke sample mein sab se aam wazan).

book_ref.quote: the most common size of seeds in a population

blocks.prompt:
28 Find the mode of the number of petals counted on seven flowers: 3, 5, 5, 6, 5, 4, 6.
(Saat phoolon par gini gayi pattiyon (petals) ki tadaad 3, 5, 5, 6, 5, 4, 6 ka mode nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Frequencies: 3 → 1, 4 → 1, 5 → 3, 6 → 2. 5 sab se zyada (3 baar) aata hai, is liye mode = 5 petals.

book_ref.quote: The mode is simply the value or values that appear more frequently in a data set.

blocks.prompt:
29 Write the formula for the mode of grouped data and name its terms.
(Grouped data ke mode ka formula likhein aur us ke terms ke naam batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Mode = l + (fm − f₁) / [(fm − f₁) + (fm − f₂)] × h, jahan l = modal class ki lower boundary, fm = modal class ki frequency, f₁ = us se pehle wali class ki frequency, f₂ = baad wali class ki frequency, h = class width.

book_ref.quote: For grouped data the mode can be calculated by using the given formula:

blocks.prompt:
30 What is a modal class? How is it identified?
(Modal class kya hai? Yeh kaise pehchani jati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Modal class grouped data ki woh class interval hai jis ki frequency sab se zyada ho. Frequency table mein sab se bari frequency dekh kar pehchani jati hai; is ki lower boundary mode formula mein l hai.

book_ref.quote: Consider we are studying the weight (kg) distribution of animals in a zoo.

blocks.prompt:
31 Define standard deviation. Write its use in biology.
(Standard deviation ki definition likhein. Biology mein is ka istemal batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Standard deviation yeh naapti hai ke data mean ke muqable mein kitna bikhra hua hai. Biology mein yeh pemaishon ki variability jaanchne ke liye istemal hoti hai, jaise paudon ki growth rates ya sample mein enzymes ki concentration.

book_ref.quote: A standard deviation is a measure of how dispersed the data is in relation to the mean.

blocks.prompt:
32 Differentiate between low and high standard deviation.
(Kam aur zyada standard deviation mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Kam SD: data mean ke qareeb; zyada SD: data phaila hua.

book_ref.quote: high, or large, standard deviation indicates data are more spread out

rows: Data mean ke gird qareeb jama
Data zyada phaila hua
Zero ke qareeb: points mean ke bohat qareeb
Points mean se door phaile hue
Normal curve tang, mean ke gird jama
Normal curve chaura, zyada phaila hua

blocks.prompt:
33 Write the formula of standard deviation and explain its symbols.
(Standard deviation ka formula likhein aur us ki alamaat samjhayein.)
blocks.explanation: σ = √[Σ(xᵢ − µ)² / N], jahan σ = standard deviation, xᵢ = har data point, µ = mean aur N = data points ki kul tadaad.

book_ref.quote: xᵢ = each individual data point in the set

blocks.prompt:
34 Why are deviations squared while calculating standard deviation? What is variance?
(Standard deviation nikalte waqt deviations ka square kyun lete hain? Variance kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Square karne se negative qeematein khatam hoti hain aur bare deviations numayan hote hain. Squared deviations ka average, Σ(xᵢ − µ)²/N, variance hai; us ka square root standard deviation hai.

book_ref.quote: Step3: Square the result of each deviation

blocks.prompt:
35 The mean height of a group of seedlings is 16 cm. Find the deviation and squared deviation of a seedling 12 cm tall and of one 21 cm tall.
(Paudon (seedlings) ke aik group ki mean oonchai 16 cm hai. 12 cm aur 21 cm oonche paudon ka deviation aur squared deviation nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: Step2: Subtract the mean from each data point to find the deviation of each point.

blocks.prompt:
36 Define range and write its formula.
(Range ki definition likhein aur formula likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Range data ki sab se bari aur sab se chhoti qeemat ka farq hai; yeh variability ki sab se saada shakal hai. Range = Xmax − Xmin.

book_ref.quote: The range represents the difference between the maximum and minimum values in a dataset.

blocks.prompt:
37 Differentiate between a large range and a small range.
(Bari range aur chhoti range mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Bari range zyada phailao; chhoti range qareeb jama data.

book_ref.quote: while a smaller range indicates that the data points are closely clustered around a central value

rows: Data ka zyada phailao
Data ka kam phailao
Points aik doosre se zyada bikhre hue
Points markazi qeemat ke gird qareeb jama

blocks.prompt:
38 The wing lengths (mm) of four insects are 12, 30, 25 and 18. Find the range.
(Chaar keeron ke paron ki lambai (mm) 12, 30, 25 aur 18 hai. Range nikalein.)
blocks.explanation:
Tarteeb: 12, 18, 25, 30. Xmax = 30, Xmin = 12.
Range = Xmax − Xmin = 30 − 12 = 18 mm.

book_ref.quote: Step 2: Identify the greatest value in the dataset.

blocks.prompt:
39 Define percentile. Why are percentiles useful in biostatistics?
(Percentile ki definition likhein. Biostatistics mein percentiles kyun mufeed hain?)
blocks.explanation: Percentile data ki woh qeemat hai jis se neeche observations ka diya gaya feesad hissa aata hai. Percentiles biological data ki distribution samajhne mein madad dete hain, chahe woh skewed (tircha) ho ya normal.

book_ref.quote: Percentiles are particularly useful in biostatistics

blocks.prompt:
40 Write the formula for the rank of a percentile. What is done if the rank is not an integer?
(Percentile ke rank ka formula likhein. Agar rank poora adad na ho to kya kiya jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: R = (P/100) × (n + 1), jahan R = rank, P = matloob percentile, n = observations ki tadaad. Agar R poora adad ho to Rth position wali qeemat percentile hai; warna do qareebi ranks ke darmiyan interpolation (darmiyani andaza) kiya jata hai.

book_ref.quote: If R is not an integer (e.g., 4.4), interpolation between the two nearest ranks is used

blocks.prompt:
41 For 9 ordered observations, find the rank of the 50th percentile.
(9 tarteeb wali observations ke liye 50th percentile ka rank nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: R = (P/100)(n + 1) = 50/100 × (9 + 1) = 5. R poora adad hai, is liye 50th percentile 5th position wali qeemat hai (median).

blocks.prompt:
42 What is a bar chart? Give its use in biology.
(Bar chart kya hai? Biology mein is ka istemal batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Bar chart categorical data ki mustateel bars wali tasweeri shakal hai jis mein bar ki lambai ya oonchai qeemat ke mutanasib hoti hai. Biology mein yeh species ki ginti, experimental groups ya biological samples ki pemaishein dikhata hai.

book_ref.quote: Bar charts are used to compare quantities across distinct categories or groups.

blocks.prompt:
43 Write the key characteristics of a bar chart.
(Bar chart ki ahem khususiyaat likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Categories x-axis (ufuqi axis) par hoti hain.
2. Qeematein ya frequencies y-axis (amoodi axis) par hoti hain.
3. Bars amoodi ya ufuqi dono tarah ho sakte hain.

book_ref.quote: Values or frequencies are represented by the y-axis (vertical axis).

blocks.prompt:
44 In the insect diversity bar chart, name the categorical and numerical variables and the axis of each.
(Keeron ki iqsaam wale bar chart mein categorical aur numerical variables aur un ke axis ke naam batayein.)
blocks.explanation:
Categorical variable: keeron ki species (ladybug, ant, butterfly, bee, dragonfly) x-axis par.
Numerical variable: gine gaye afraad ki tadaad y-axis par.

book_ref.quote: Purpose: To visually compare the abundance of five different insect species.

blocks.prompt:
45 How is the numerical axis of a bar chart scaled? Explain with the insect example.
(Bar chart ka numerical axis kaise scale kiya jata hai? Keeron ki misaal se samjhayein.)
blocks.explanation: Scale sab se bari qeemat se thoda aage aasan izafe ke saath rakha jata hai. Sab se bari ginti 120 (ants) thi, is liye y-axis 0 se 140 tak 20 ke izafe se rakha gaya taa ke parhna aasan ho.

book_ref.quote: Greatest value is 120 (Ants).

blocks.prompt:
46 Differentiate between range error bars and standard deviation error bars.
(Range error bars aur standard deviation error bars mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Range error bars poora phailao; SD error bars mean ke gird phailao.

book_ref.quote: Standard deviation error bars show the average distance of each data point from the mean.

rows: Sab se chhoti aur sab se bari qeemat istemal karte hain
Har data point ka mean se average faasla dikhate hain
Minimum se maximum tak jaate hain
Mean se aik ya zyada SD upar aur neeche (±SD)
Data ka poora phailao dikhate hain
Bar wale group mean ke gird phailao dikhate hain

blocks.prompt:
47 Plants in a group are 21, 24 and 27 cm tall. Find the mean and the limits of the range error bar.
(Aik group ke paude 21, 24 aur 27 cm oonche hain. Mean aur range error bar ki hudood nikalein.)
blocks.explanation:
Mean = (21 + 24 + 27)/3 = 72/3 = 24 cm (bar ki oonchai).
Range error bar: minimum 21 cm se maximum 27 cm tak (range 6 cm, ±3 cm).

book_ref.quote: Step 1: Calculate the mean of each group

blocks.prompt:
48 What is a pie chart? Give two biological examples of its use.
(Pie chart kya hai? Is ke istemal ki do biological misalein dein.)
blocks.explanation: Pie chart aik gol statistical graph hai jo sectors mein taqseem hota hai, har sector poore ka aik hissa; har sector ka angle us category ke hisse ke mutanasib hai. Misalein: cells ki iqsaam, species ki distribution (ya survey ke jawabat).

book_ref.quote: The entire circle corresponds to 100% (or 360°)

blocks.prompt:
49 Out of 125 seeds, 25 failed to germinate. Find the sector angle for this category in a pie chart.
(125 beejon mein se 25 nahi ugay. Pie chart mein is category ka sector angle nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Sector angle = (category value / total value) × 360° = 25/125 × 360° = 72°.

book_ref.quote: Step 2: Add up all frequency values to get the total sum

blocks.prompt:
50 How are the sectors of a pie chart drawn and labelled?
(Pie chart ke sectors kaise banaye aur label kiye jaate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Daira banayein aur aik reference line (radius) se shuru kar ke protractor se har sector angle tarteeb se banayein, clockwise ya counter-clockwise. Alag rang ya shades lagayein, har sector par label, zaroorat ho to legend aur aik wazeh title dein.

book_ref.quote: Draw a circle by using a protractor, draw each sector angle in sequence

blocks.prompt:
51 What is the x-axis of a data figure? What does it usually represent?
(Data figure ka x-axis kya hai? Yeh aam taur par kya zahir karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: X-axis Cartesian coordinate system ya data figure ki ufuqi line hai jo baayen se daayen chalti aur aksar origin (0, 0) se shuru hoti hai. Yeh aam taur par independent variable zahir karta hai, jaise waqt ke waqfe, species ya experimental halaat.

book_ref.quote: The x-axis refers to the horizontal line on a Cartesian coordinate system

blocks.prompt:
52 In the enzyme activity figure, name the variable on each axis and its unit.
(Enzyme activity wale figure mein har axis ka variable aur us ki unit batayein.)
blocks.explanation:
X-axis: independent variable, temperature, °C mein (5, 10, 20, 30, 40 °C).
Y-axis: dependent variable, enzyme activity, μmol/min mein.

book_ref.quote: Independent variable (x-axis): Temperature, measured in degrees Celsius

blocks.prompt:
53 What is experimental design?
(Experimental design kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Experimental design kisi khayal ko test karne ke liye experiment ki ehtiyat se planning hai. Scientists subjects tay karte, halaat control karte taa ke nataij munsifana hon, aik cheez (independent variable) badalte aur doosri (dependent variable) par asar dekhte hain taa ke hypothesis ka sahi ya ghalat hona maloom ho.

book_ref.quote: They decide subjects or participants and control the conditions so results are fair.

blocks.prompt:
54 Differentiate between independent variable and control variables.
(Independent variable aur control variables mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Independent variable badla jata hai; control variables yaksaan rakhe jaate hain.

book_ref.quote: Control variables (or constants) are all the other factors

rows: Woh factor jise experimenter badalta hai
Baqi tamam factors jo poore experiment mein yaksaan rahein
Is ka asar dependent variable par dekha jata hai
Munsifana test ke liye yaksaan rakhe jaate hain
Choohon ka experiment: diet ki qisam
Choohon ka experiment: umar, strain, jins, pinjra, mahol, khilane ka schedule

blocks.prompt:
55 Differentiate between a control group and an experimental group.
(Control group aur experimental group mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Control group ko treatment nahi milta; experimental group ko milta hai.

book_ref.quote: An experimental group is a group that is exposed to the specific treatment

rows: Treatment ya independent variable ki tabdeeli nahi milti
Test hone wala treatment, halat ya tabdeeli milti hai
Muqable ke liye baseline (buniyad) ka kaam deta hai
Is ke nataij control group se mila kar dekhe jaate hain
Choohon ka experiment: normal diet wale choohe
Choohon ka experiment: high-fat diet wale choohe

blocks.prompt:
56 What should the procedure of an experiment outline?
(Experiment ke tareeqa-e-kaar (procedure) mein kya likha hona chahiye?)
blocks.explanation: Is mein tafseeli qadam hon: subjects kaise chune aur groups mein baante jayein, har group se kya kiya jaye, pemaish ki muddat aur kitni baar, aur data kaise jama ho.

book_ref.quote: Plan the procedure and outline detailed steps on how experiments will be conducted

blocks.prompt:
57 State the question and hypothesis of the albino mice diet experiment.
(Albino choohon ke diet experiment ka sawal aur hypothesis likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Sawal: Kya high-fat diet choohon mein normal diet ke muqable mein zyada wazan barhati hai?
Hypothesis: High-fat diet wale choohe normal diet walon se zyada wazan barhayenge.

book_ref.quote: Hypothesis: Mice given a high-fat diet will gain more weight than those on a normal diet.

blocks.prompt:
58 When will the hypothesis of the mice experiment be rejected?
(Choohon ke experiment ka hypothesis kab radd hoga?)
blocks.explanation: Agar groups mein koi significant farq na ho, ya normal diet wala group zyada wazan barhaye, to hypothesis radd hoga. Is se lagta hai ke diet ke ilawa doosre factors wazan barhne mein zyada kirdar ada karte hain.

book_ref.quote: However, if there is no significant difference between groups

blocks.prompt:
59 Why are the mice matched by age, strain and sex and housed under identical conditions?
(Choohon ko umar, strain aur jins mein mila kar aur yaksaan halaat mein kyun rakha jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh control variables hain. Inhein yaksaan rakhne (aik jaise pinjre, roshni, temperature, nami) se test munsifana hota hai, taa ke wazan ka farq sirf diet ki qisam ki wajah se ho.

book_ref.quote: House all albino mice under identical conditions
